name: @eisensoftware/gateway
description: Registry-driven API gateway for eisensoftware.com: Node 20 + Hono + TypeScript in a hexagonal layout, packaged for Cloud Run.

scripts.build: npm run build:snapshot && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/adapters/outbound/registry/snapshot.json dist/adapters/outbound/registry/snapshot.json
scripts.dev: npm run build:snapshot && tsx watch src/main.ts
scripts.pretest: npm run typecheck && npm run check:layers
